newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan parliament ends session ahead of elections.
newsitem.headline: Jordan parliament ends session ahead of elections.

text.p: Jordan's parliament will convene its last session on Wednesday ahead of multi-party national elections due next November, officials said on Saturday.
They said King Hussein issued a royal decree on Saturday ending parliament's current ordinary session on March 19.
This year's elections will be the third since King Hussein set in motion a democratisation process in 1989 after nearly 40 years of absolute rule.
